source_of_truth: Visual Operating Console roadmap plus existing architecture-map substrate. This child plan turns the existing architecture.json output into a first-class local dashboard Architecture tab with an interactive flow map/explorer, not just a static iframe.

user_journeys.name: operator-opens-architecture-tab-and-understands-system-shape
user_journeys.description: An operator opens the Architecture tab and sees a swimlane map of system areas, modules, plans, capabilities, and relationships with plain-language labels and source/provenance.
acceptance_signals: Architecture tab appears in the dashboard without waiting for the broader value-language IA plan
Flow map renders from architecture.json without hardcoded demo data
Swimlanes and node labels are readable
Source path and generated_at are visible

user_journeys.name: operator-selects-flow-and-sees-path-light-up
user_journeys.description: An operator chooses a flow such as dashboard open, capability setup, plan dispatch, audit/signoff, or architecture regen and the map highlights the relevant path with numbered steps.
acceptance_signals: Flow list is visible
Selecting a flow highlights related nodes and edges
Numbered markers match the step inspector order
Step list is scrollable when the selected flow has many steps
Non-participating map content is visually de-emphasized without disappearing entirely
Clear selection returns the map to the neutral state

user_journeys.name: operator-searches-and-drills-into-a-module
user_journeys.description: An operator searches for a module or file, selects it in the flow map, and sees related imports, plans, changed files, flow participation, and exact source metadata in a detail panel.
acceptance_signals: Search filters graph content
Clicking a node opens a detail panel
Detail panel includes related nodes and source metadata
Technical identifiers remain copyable or selectable

user_journeys.name: operator-filters-relationships-without-losing-context
user_journeys.description: An operator filters to modules, plans, capabilities, changed areas, or high-coupling areas and can reset to the full map without losing project context.
acceptance_signals: At least three useful filters exist
Filtered state preserves selected project
Empty filter results have an honest empty state
Reset returns to the full graph

user_journeys.name: operator-sees-stale-or-missing-architecture-and-gets-exact-command
user_journeys.description: When the architecture artifact is stale or missing, the tab explains the issue in plain language and emits the exact regen command instead of auto-mutating the repo.
acceptance_signals: Stale/missing state is visible
Exact regen command is copyable
Dashboard does not auto-write architecture files
No secret values appear in the graph or empty state

user_journeys.name: agent-reads-architecture-view-state-without-scraping-html
user_journeys.description: An agent can read a generated architecture-view JSON/cache shape for graph nodes, edges, filters, freshness, and selected project without scraping the visual DOM.
acceptance_signals: Architecture view state JSON exists after dashboard build
Lanes, nodes, edges, flows, and steps include stable IDs and types
Freshness state is represented
Shape is snapshot-tested

completion_test: A local operator runs `dontpanic dashboard serve`, opens Architecture, and sees a production-quality interactive swimlane flow map sourced from architecture.json. They can select a flow, see the path light up with numbered steps, inspect step/node details, search, filter, inspect source/provenance, understand project/fleet architecture state, see stale/missing states, and copy the exact regen command. The dashboard remains read-only, writes an agent-readable architecture view-state cache, and passes desktop/mobile screenshot checks.
